name: scribase
description: Create and operate Scribase backends (Postgres, Auth, Storage, Realtime, Functions; works with supabase-js) with the Scribase MCP server and skills.

interface.longDescription: Provision a Scribase project, write .env, create tables with row level security, wire Apple and Google sign-in, storage, realtime and edge functions, and work on a preview branch per task. Every mutating MCP tool requires explicit confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Create a Scribase project for this app and write the keys to .env
Add a todos table with row level security and generate types
Open a Scribase preview branch for this task and apply my migrations there
